alternatives_considered: Potential third-party RCM vendors via future RFP
battlecards.why_selected: Agreed to reduce fee to 3.15 % of collections with pricing applied retroactively, avoiding costly system switch and preserving integrated EHR/PM workflow.
battlecards.contract_terms: Addendum to existing MSO agreement; 3-year rate lock at 3.15 % of collections, retroactive to 9/1/2022; current master agreement runs through Jan-2025.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Benchmarks showed current 2.75 – 3.67 % tiers out-of-market; Advantia threatened RFP and migration to Collector if pricing not improved.
supplier_strengths: Fully integrated EHR, PM, and patient engagement modules
battlecards.switching_costs: System migration, data conversion, provider retraining, and $9 M early-termination fee.

battlecards.why_selected: Provided lowest total landed cost across full formulary, could service both Mid-Atlantic and Heartland regions, and accepted 60-day payment terms.
battlecards.contract_terms: Enterprise-wide prime-distributor agreement starting 10/31/2022; 3-year term with QBRs, dedicated implementation resources, and 60-day net terms.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Shift of Heartland volume away from Medline plus competitive pricing feedback from four bidders.
supplier_weaknesses: Will need to scale support team for Heartland go-live
battlecards.switching_costs: Heartland staff retraining on McKesson ordering portal; minor item number conversions.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Unable to match McKesson’s total cost and 60-day terms; would have required maintaining dual-distributor model.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Advantia’s threat to move all Heartland volume; visibility to competitor pricing.
supplier_weaknesses: Would not extend payment terms beyond 30 days
battlecards.switching_costs: Heartland practices transitioned SKUs and ordering portal to McKesson.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Pay-per-scan model priced ≥20 % above market; unwilling to lower rates; limited flexibility.
battlecards.contract_terms: Prior agreement: $50 per scan, Net 30 invoices.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Ability to insource staff and competitive quote from Staffmark.
supplier_weaknesses: High unit cost, little transparency into tech quality, no volume discounts
battlecards.switching_costs: Recruiting and onboarding costs for internal hires; scheduling adjustments during transition.

battlecards.why_selected: Offers variable cost model to supplement 20 % of demand while internal recruiting scales; second-lowest total cost.
battlecards.contract_terms: Recruiter-on-demand agreement; estimated 20 % utilization; fee per successful placement; no fixed term.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Competition with incumbent and internal hiring option.
supplier_weaknesses: Per-hire fees higher than fully internal model
battlecards.switching_costs: Low—service can be discontinued with 30-day notice.
complexity_reasons: New supplier added to hybrid model

battlecards.why_selected: Offered acceptable 10 % price reduction while preserving embedded phlebotomists and LIS interfaces.
battlecards.contract_terms: Updated pricing schedule effective 10/15/2022; no change in service scope; annual review clause.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Quest BAFO showed 19 % savings, providing credible switch threat.
supplier_strengths: Existing integrations with Athena, onsite phlebotomy staffing
supplier_weaknesses: Pricing still higher than Quest on key tests
Past due invoices flagged in AP
battlecards.switching_costs: Re-interfacing EHR/LIS, specimen logistics changes, staff re-training.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Offered 19 % savings but change management (interfaces, logistics) deemed too disruptive relative to incremental savings.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Used as competitive benchmark to pressure incumbent.
supplier_weaknesses: No existing integration, higher implementation effort
battlecards.switching_costs: High—new courier routes, interface builds, staff training.
complexity_reasons: Provided price benchmark but not selected

summary.skipped_reason: Suppliers in IUD programs, Bayer replacement program, Hologic reagents, and IT MSP were skipped due to limited negotiation data or simple behavioral changes.
